data.rationale: The proposal follows the same path (DEALS, then Deals & Promotions, then a region selector, then pick a region) with the correct region parameter. It calls the selector a "Display deals in" dropdown, whereas the true flow clicks "All Regions". A built automation would probably still find the control, but that label is a likely point of failure.
